dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Moderate contrast; repetitive thin horizontal light-buff bands formed by the distal edges of the median and greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence; sharp, thin pale boundaries are clearly visible along the outer margins of the folded primaries and secondaries.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Low distinctness; a gradual transition exists between the fine longitudinal streaking of the crown and the larger scalloped patterns of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly regular scalloped dorsal appearance created by dark feather centers with broad, pale-buff fringes.
